_readme: One entry per thing that stays with the house. floor: main | second | basement. x,y: position in floor-plan units (same as img/floorplan/*.py, 15.27 units per foot); leave both null if the spot isn't known yet. photo: path under img/items/. directory: rows typed from a panel's door label. Alarm/security items are NOT kept here in readable form: they live only in data/security.enc.json, encrypted in the browser with a password written inside the security panel door.

items.name: Main breaker panel
items.notes: Primary electric panel, in the basement. Square D Homeline load center. Breakers 17, 19, 21, 23, 25 and 27 are 20 A single-pole Homeline breakers (HOM120), and breaker 29 is 15 A. None of these is an AFCI or GFCI breaker. Floor-heat circuits: the owner said in November 2026 that GFCI breakers are already in the panel, but nobody has checked at the panel yet. If they are missing, the planned part is the Square D HOM120GFI (HOM115GFI for a 15 A circuit). Room within the basement: not recorded yet.

items.name: Mechanical room
items.notes: Long narrow room, about 5½ × 15 ft, between the playroom and the bath. Doors from the playroom. Equipment inside: not recorded yet.

items.name: Upstairs HVAC unit
items.notes: In the closet on the west wall of the office over the garage, just south of the entry. Brand/model: not recorded yet.

items.name: Thermostat: main floor
items.notes: Honeywell T5 (Resideo / First Alert app), also scheduled by Home Assistant. Wall location not recorded yet.

items.name: Thermostat: upstairs
items.notes: On the wall in the Primary Bedroom on the second floor. Honeywell T5 smart thermostat. Since November 2026 it has used the Resideo Connect (First Alert) app. Home Assistant runs its schedule. Which HVAC unit it controls: not recorded yet.

items.name: Floor heat control, zone 1
items.notes: SunTouch FloorStat 500600-120 (original, display dead). Planned replacement: Shelly 1PM Gen4 UL. Room not recorded yet. Wiring: see Heated floors section.

items.name: Floor heat control, zone 2
items.notes: SunTouch FloorStat 500600-120 (original, display dead). Planned replacement: Shelly 1PM Gen4 UL. Room not recorded yet.

items.name: Floor heat control, zone 3
items.notes: SunTouch FloorStat 500600-120 (original, display dead). Planned replacement: Shelly 1PM Gen4 UL. Room not recorded yet.

items.name: Floor heat control, zone 4
items.notes: SunTouch FloorStat 500600-120 (original, display dead). Planned replacement: Shelly 1PM Gen4 UL. Room not recorded yet.

items.name: Electrical sub-panel
items.notes: Electrical sub-panel in the basement theater. This is a separate panel from the main breaker panel. Brand, model, breaker sizes and the circuits it feeds: not recorded yet.

items.name: Upstairs electrical panel
items.notes: Electrical panel for the upstairs, on the second floor. It is separate from the main breaker panel and the sub-panel in the basement theater. Room: not recorded yet. Brand, model, breaker sizes and the circuits it feeds: not recorded yet.

items.name: Internet modem (Altafiber)
items.notes: Altafiber fiber internet modem, in the Unfinished Attic on the second floor. Fiber service (Fioptics) was installed on September 17, 2026. Modem brand and model: not recorded yet.
